name: foliogrid-card-binder
description: Offline universal collectible-card binder for iPhone

scripts.serve: npm run prepare:www && npx http-server www -p 5174 -c-1
scripts.cap:sync: npm run prepare:www && npx cap sync ios
scripts.ios:add: npm run prepare:www && npx cap add ios
scripts.ios:open: npm run cap:sync && npx cap open ios
